claims.statement: For fixed epsilon in (0,1/52), C0>=1 and Co=max(C0,2), the actual inert-class Ltwo is at most 2(620Co/epsilon+1), uniformly over the host data and including an empty defining set. No prime splitting or field existence is inferred without the supplied row.

The actual step is h_p on inert candidates; the base may depend on the marked point and absolute parity is retained. Replacing TT leaves all selection inputs and HostAx unchanged.

claims.title: The five auxiliary primes with exact norm, congruence and BB-disjointness conditions
claims.statement: ShortNorm gives >=Y^(9/10) actual NormOne primes at logY>=8x^epsilon. An elementary exceptional-root count excludes at most 20r^3Y^(3/4) candidates, yielding BB-disjoint norm primes at Y=(kb)^8. SmallOne gives three further distinct primes at most N^(2a^3+4a^2+a), eventually below b.

claims.statement: A finite sphere/base-expansion construction gives size >=n exp(-32sqrt(logn logL))/L with the exact signed NoRel predicate. Uniform logarithmic bounds and erasing zero give the actual T2 with CT2=64, |T2|>=x^-epsilon n and 4Lwv|T2|<=n0. This T2 is separate from the biased TT.

claims.statement: RankVal gives r<=x5 and t<=x400 uniformly. PairWin/WinPair imply q,d>4tr+1 and d>=100; the explicit log budget gives log(Qqd)<=2Y^(epsilon/5)(logY)^2 and all PairRow clauses. The calculation uses raw data, avoiding a temporary arbitrary host.

claims.statement: The actual NormOne equation explicitly constructs pi=1+M(v+u(1+sqrt(-d))/2), with norm p and pi=1 mod M. Supplied trivial Frobenius and inertia imply full splitting. CRT and real-character conductor classification transfer PairGood to the actual QDq, Boxq, BoxH, RealBox and dlog bounds, retaining the full stated zero-box domain.

claims.statement: For epsilon,C0 fixed first, choose CT2=64, C8=max(C0,C1), C5=4 and uniform c6,Cb/threshold. Every actual input satisfying the report's field, rank, pair and modulus hypotheses gives HostGood plus Shares with unchanged HostAx. The source admitted premise has been discharged by HC4.

claims.statement: The exact dyadic rescaling with kappa=c^(1/h) turns supplied VWinAt(psi,401) and PairEx into exponent-3/2 host windows, preserves the selected field and yields EAtH and VVle(E,t,sqrt b). The host-only o=1 specialization uses M=J=1 and needs no VWinAt, but does not assert VVle or complete RH.
